text: One of the biggest problems with manual trading is overcoming impulsive behaviour and not falling into the trap laid by fear and greed. Even for a seasoned discretionary trader, it takes years to master the psychological aspect of trading. Many successful discretionary traders prefer going rules-based and systematic, but until a few months ago there was a technical barrier. Coming up with your own rules, experience and strategy was not enough. If you were not from a software background, you only had two options, share your strategy with someone who can code, so that they can build your execution system for you, or do it all yourself by learning to code from scratch.
